source_taste.reason: The new motion layer gives the Christmas-light scene graph one bounded consequence while retaining non-color/text/TalkBack truth. The warm wall was mutated in place instead of spawning a replacement overlay organism.

accessibility.reason: Surface presentation and platform animator permission are mandatory; reduced/disabled motion can suppress the visual cue without suppressing state information. Runtime behavior remains unproven.

review_scar.reason: Initial summary fallback used one vague rejection boundary for both frame clamp and node-owned transition. Regnet/code review split those into exact boundaries before this completion review.

next_exact_wound: Wire the existing OperatorOverlayService, and only that owner, to consume HeartbeatNativeMotionPolicy using actual heartbeat-surface visibility plus platform animator enablement; apply one bounded cue to transitioning Buttons and the existing summary for pure removal. Do not touch P0/phone lanes and do not create a second animator/controller.
